//: ainb-hooks managed drop-in, written verbatim to ~/.copilot/hooks/ainb.json by `ainb-notifyd install --copilot`. Do not edit by hand; uninstall deletes this whole file. Unlike Codex (one shared ~/.codex/hooks.json merged in place), Copilot loads every *.json in ~/.copilot/hooks/ and combines them, so ainb owns this one file standalone. Only the events that need the human are registered (notification = awaiting-input/permission, agentStop = turn finished). Telemetry events are intentionally NOT hooked — they would bury the signal. The daemon also drops any non-user-facing event defensively.
